title: Why did last month’s territory revenue change?
visibility: All fixture input rows, schemas and business rules are visible before attempting or running the selected example. The required output columns, grain and comparison rules are always available; expected-versus-actual values may appear after Run. Worked SQL and explanation appear only after explicit Reveal. Examples are public teaching material, not private assessment.

source_pin.source_case: historical-sales-territory-model is concept provenance only; its Premium prose, fixture, answer, identity, access and progress are not reused or changed.

outcome: Given fictional order lines and effective-dated territory history, produce sale-time and supplied-as-of territory reports that each conserve all order lines and integer amounts; explain a backdated correction and identify invalid overlapping history.
business_context: Fictional retailer January sales total remains 520 units; the allocation by territory differs between sale-time finance and 15 February as-of planning reports. A supplied backdated effective-time correction changes historical allocation without changing total sales.

assumptions.dialect: SQLite 3.49.1 via SQL.js 1.14.1 browser read-only SELECT/WITH; timestamp TEXT compares lexically only because all values use identical zero-padded UTC YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format.
assumptions.amount: Fictional integer units; positive, comparable, no refunds/tax/FX or status filters.
assumptions.interval: valid_from inclusive, valid_to exclusive, NULL end open; effective time is business attribution, not loaded/recorded time.
assumptions.as_of: 2026-02-15 00:00:00 UTC is the supplied effective-time query instant for every fact, not proof of what was previously published.
assumptions.unknown: Zero matching history intervals maps to the literal Unknown; never drop the fact.
assumptions.conflict: Any overlapping intervals for one customer invalidate the input; block both reports and show the customer and interval pair before comparing outputs.
assumptions.permitted_state: This public teaching packet has no new account/entitlement/progress policy. Drafts and correction state are local-device only until Engineering/Product verify an existing suitable persistence path.

stages.label: As of 15 February 2026 00:00:00 UTC
stages.starter_sql: SELECT order_id, line_id, customer_id, sale_ts, amount FROM orders LIMIT 10;

hints.text: Identify one fact row and the timestamp used by each report; count lines before grouping.
Count history matches per fact at the chosen timestamp: zero is Unknown, one is valid, more than one is conflict. Test O2 at the exclusive end.
Use a left join with the interval rule in ON, group by COALESCE territory, and reconcile line and amount totals.

validation_contract.preflight: Before any report evaluation, check overlapping per-customer intervals independent of whether current facts land in the overlap. Report conflicted key/interval; do not choose a winner.
validation_contract.compare: For nonempty valid cases, require exact requested headers in order and finite integer amount/count cells, with unordered territory row tuples and preserved multiplicity. The current shared comparator lowercases headers and rounds numeric values to six decimals, so future feature-local validation must inspect raw actual output and not trust its passed boolean. No keyword or solution syntax mandate. Every fact contributes once to count and amount.
states: result mismatch with expected versus actual and conservation
validation_contract.empty_result_adapter_limit: The current browser-sql adapter reports columns=[] for zero-row SQL.js exec, so empty fixture verifies zero rows only; do not claim alias metadata passed.
validation_contract.wrong_answer_interpretation: Each wrong strategy is rejected on at least one disclosed fixture by actual adapter; a baseline constant passes baseline, so changed-input evidence is essential.
validation_contract.empty_example: No rows expected for this empty input. This check verifies zero rows only; column names are checked on nonempty examples. Empty-example completion cannot pass the full exercise; both reports must be completed on nonempty examples.

correction_and_recovery.supplied_change: C1 North valid_to and South valid_from both move from 2026-01-10 00:00:00 to 2026-01-09 12:00:00 UTC; original snapshot retained.
correction_and_recovery.affected_interval: C1, [2026-01-09 12:00:00, 2026-01-10 00:00:00); O1 is the only supplied affected line.
correction_and_recovery.retry: Preserve both query drafts and selected snapshot after syntax/data/result/engine failures; allow repeat run. Stage switch preserves both drafts. Restart restores original snapshot after a discard warning.
correction_and_recovery.stale_result: Invalidate prior match when either query or input snapshot changes; identify which version was checked.
correction_and_recovery.worker_budget: Engineering20 proposes a feature-local worker with a calibrated query budget, explicit Cancel/terminate/recreate, stale-reply rejection and retry preserving both drafts and the chosen snapshot. Author packet does not claim this runtime exists.

tradeoffs: Materialized fact-to-dimension-version key simplifies reads but a late effective-time correction needs bounded audited fact repair.
Query-time temporal join can reflect corrected history but needs overlap/cardinality checks and measured cost.
Neither report reconstructs the originally published version of history without an additional source/report-version record.
operational_checks: Reconcile fact line count and integer amount before/after correction.
Alert on zero and multiple history matches; queue Unknown for later source correction without dropping facts.
Record correction source/version and exact affected customer/interval; do not claim actual warehouse backfill.

integration_acceptance.content: All input rows/schema/rules visible before attempt; required columns/grain/rules always visible, expected-versus-actual may follow Run; only worked SQL/explanation requires Reveal. Product exact learner acceptance pending.
integration_acceptance.engineering: Confirm original Free route/module/public-only asset boundary, worker/WASM/CSP load, cancellation and finite integer/header checks, overlap preflight, local-only persistence/revision conflicts and unchanged Premium/SQL regressions; do not modify shared runner or Premium case without separate gate.
integration_acceptance.ui: Task/Data/Help and two editors preserve drafts; 360px and desktop light/dark, keyboard focus, table scroll, Cancel/retry/reload/correction, never-edited starter and empty editor. A stopped or stale run must not show a pass.
integration_acceptance.release: Separate CEO guarded release order and public receipt; no current deployment.

measurement_limits: Revealing answer is reviewed practice, not pass.
Matching finite public examples does not establish unseen transfer or independent mastery.
